name: vtn-host
description: Verifiable Trust Network (VTN) service identity, for the vtn binary. A VTN curates a set of communities and networks (dtgwg-vti-spec 11a-vtn.md) and is provisioned on a VTA, from which it derives its identity (VTI-VTN-001). Declares an Ed25519 key (#key-0), which is assertionMethod and authentication: it signs listings, membership grants, the network index and status lists. Also declares an X25519 key-agreement key (#key-1). Advertises the VTN API at API_URL (no trailing slash): `VerifiableTrustNetwork` at {API_URL}/v1, and `LinkedDomains` at API_URL. URL or WEBVH_SERVER is still required at provision time, so that the VTA knows where to publish the did:webvh log.
